entities.summary: Valerian Savelievich (Saulovich) Dovgalevsky was a member of the Bolshevik revolutionary movement, Soviet statesman, diplomat and People's Commissar of Posts and Telegraphs of the Russian Socialist Federative Soviet Republic.
